rules.source: Law on Personal Data Protection (PDP Law), enacted by the National Assembly, effective 1 January 2026 — elevates the prior Decree No.13/2023/ND-CP (Personal Data Protection Decree, effective 1 July 2023, 44 articles/4 chapters) to full statutory law. Summary: https://fpf.org/blog/vietnams-personal-data-protection-decree-overview-key-takeaways-and-context/ and https://www.hlc.com/en/publications/vietnam-enacts-landmark-law-on-personal-data-protection-stable-standing-with-stricter-compliance
rules.retrieved_snippet: Applies to Vietnamese and foreign agencies/organizations/individuals in Vietnam, Vietnamese entities operating abroad, and foreign entities processing personal data related to Vietnam. Mandates lawfulness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimization, accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.

rules.source: Decree 147/2024/ND-CP, requiring parental registration and supervision of social media accounts for children under 16; a further draft amendment (2026) proposes restricting under-16 users to view-only access (no posting/commenting/sharing/reacting). Summary: https://vietnamnet.vn/en/new-vietnam-law-mandates-parental-registration-for-child-online-accounts-2531595.html and https://thediplomat.com/2026/07/vietnam-planning-social-media-restrictions-for-children-under-16/
rules.retrieved_snippet: A parent or legal guardian must register a child's (under-16) social media account using their own identifying information and is responsible for supervising the content the child accesses, posts, and shares. Platforms must identify child users, deliver age-appropriate content, apply the highest privacy protections to child accounts, and proactively block harmful material.

rules.source: Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights 2023 (LPCR 2023), passed 20 June 2023, effective 1 July 2024, replacing Law No.59/2010/QH12; plus Decree No.55/2024/ND-CP on digital-platform responsibilities. Summary: https://www.tilleke.com/insights/significant-aspects-of-vietnams-new-consumer-protection-law/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Defines a consumer as a person purchasing/using goods or services for non-commercial personal/family/organizational consumption. Protects vulnerable consumers (elderly, disabled, children, ethnic minorities, pregnant/nursing women, severely ill, poor households); requires disclosure of influencer sponsorships; requires prior consumer consent before a business shares their information with a third party; simplifies small-claims procedures under VND 100 million.

rules.source: Law on Cyber Security, Law No. 24/2018/QH14 (12 June 2018), effective 1 January 2019 — https://english.luatvietnam.vn/law-no-24-2018-qh14-dated-june-12-2018-of-the-national-assembly-on-cybersecurity-164904-doc1.html
rules.retrieved_snippet: Fetched page: Law on Cyber Security No. 24/2018/QH14, effective January 1, 2019; Article 26(3): providers of telecommunications, internet or value-added services in Vietnam 'shall store these data in Vietnam for a period prescribed by the Government.'
